title: THE PARTY IS THE PLAIN DEMO
why: His order of 2026-10-19: open localhost and click the demo. The separate party address mode is retired.
now: The normal title opens the demo. Its sector map starts automatically and its word editor and snip tools require Ctrl. Leaving the demo stays on the page.
